WORDS

The words manadj uses

the same names appear in the app
Archived
Hidden from the active Library until restored; files and metadata are retained.
Beatgrid
Where every beat falls in a Track. BPM is read from it.
Cameo
A guest Track that drops in over a host Track and leaves again — a double or a tease.
Compatible
Tracks whose tempo fits and whose Key, Tags, or shared artist suggest a match. Energy helps rank them.
Conductor
Plays a Set on the Decks and Mixer. A manual Deck or Mixer gesture hands control back to you.
Controller
A MIDI DJ controller driving the Decks, Mixer, and library browsing.
Cue mode
What a Hot Cue does on a paused Deck. Gated previews while held; Trigger starts playback.
Cue-slot convention
Hot Cues 1–4 lead into the drop. 4 is the drop; 3 is 8 bars before, 2 is 16 bars before, and 1 is typically 32 bars before.
Deck
One of four players, A–D. A Deck keeps playing when you switch views.
Energy
How intense a Track is, 1–5. Its own field, not a Tag.
Export
Pushes your Library out to Engine DJ, Rekordbox, or file tags. manadj's values win.
External Import
Imports metadata changes from external libraries, such as cues or analyzed Keys.
Follow mode
Filters the track list to next-Track suggestions for the playing Deck.
Hot Cue
One of 8 saved positions in a Track that you jump to while playing.
Key Lock
Keeps a Track in its Key while you move the pitch fader.
Known
Tracks connected by a Linked association, saved Transition or Cameo.
Linked
A manually marked association between two Tracks.
Mix editor
One timeline for editing any Transition, Cameo, or Routine, or reviewing a Take.
Mixer
Trim, 3-band EQ, filter, and fader per Deck, plus crossfader, master, and Beat FX.
Observed
A pair you have mixed more than once without saving anything for it.
Pickup
Hand control back to the Conductor from where the Decks are now.
Playlist
A hand-ordered list of Tracks, curated in manadj and Exported.
Promote
Turning a reviewed Take into a saved Transition (or Cameo, or Routine).
Quantize
Snaps cue placement and loops to beats; Hot Cue jumps preserve the playing Deck's beat phase.
Routine
A saved passage with three or more Track slots, captured live or authored in the Mix editor.
Session
The record of one stretch of playing, timed to the moment. Controls only, no audio.
Set
Tracks in order, where each handover points at a Transition, a Take, or a hard cut.
Setup guide
Planned for the first release — a short, skippable flow that sets up one thing, rerunnable from Settings.
Source Item
A liked track on SoundCloud.
Structure
A Track split into intro, buildup, drop, breakdown, and outro, found by Analysis.
SYNC
Decks join one shared tempo. Move any member's pitch and the group follows.
Tag
A label you put on a Track. Every Tag belongs to one Tag Category.
Tag Category
A named, colored, ordered group of Tags — Genre, Vibe, Role.
Take
A blend between two Tracks, captured automatically while you play.
Tour
Pointers to the main controls, shown the first time you open each area.
Track
An audio file with metadata, including title, artist, Key, BPM, Energy, Tags and Hot Cues.
Transition
A saved move from one Track into another, with alignment, fades, EQ, and filter moves.
Unprocessed track
Added but not yet curated — no Tags, title and artist not cleaned up.
Unresolved
A handover in a Set with nothing pinned. It uses your best saved Transition for the pair.
